content.short: TON Bridge is the official cross-chain bridge for transferring TON and USDT between TON, Ethereum, and BSC.
content.description: TON Bridge is the official, secure cross-chain bridging solution for The Open Network (TON). It enables users to seamlessly transfer assets, most notably Toncoin and USDT, between the TON blockchain and other major networks including Ethereum and Binance Smart Chain (BSC). By providing a reliable and audited path for asset interoperability, TON Bridge plays a critical role in bringing liquidity from the broader crypto market into the TON ecosystem, allowing users to leverage their holdings across multiple decentralized finance platforms.
content.meta: Transfer assets securely between TON, Ethereum, and BSC using the official TON Bridge. Find more bridges on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
